summary: Built and tested a reusable WETNESS node group (tools/wetness_layer.py, 32 controls, 11 outputs, plus a window-sill/eaves streak sub-group), put it on 11 materials of a copy of the pit village street, baked 32 maps (ground atlas + 4 cottage fronts: wet colour, roughness, clear coat, clear coat roughness, specularity, plus ground wet normal and masks) into a wet glb (25.5 MB), drew A today / B dry new materials / C wet / D heavy rain plus two close-ups in Cycles, and checked the glb in the three.js stage. The layer works on 5 different surfaces and on the street; the baked maps reproduce the live look (road baked/live 1.02, correlation 0.977). The glb maps arrive in three.js 0.169 and change the picture, but through the film's real projection code they do not reach the film (1.97 % of a moved view wears the glb surface; matte on vs off differs by 0.002). Nothing was replaced by a texture recipe (plan: only after a painter test, which was not run). Shortfalls: wet road 2.0x today's brightness (aim 1.3-1.6), wall foot band barely visible, flat stand-ins for roofs/dressed stone/colliery brick too bright, EEVEE pavement grit cure tested in one picture only, painter not tried.
wetness_layer: WETNESS node group (tools/wetness_layer.py) sits between a material's dry look and its Principled BSDF. Inputs (default): dry look Colour, Roughness, Height (0..1, 0.5 flat), Normal; Use World Geometry (1: read world position/normal; 0: use Position and Surface Up inputs, used for walls in their own coordinates and for tiles); Wetness 0..1 (0.8; 0 returns the dry look unchanged); Puddles 0..1 (0.5; calibrated threshold = 0.79 - 0.39*dial^0.80: main-camera road puddle share 3.0/7.8/16.1/29.6 % at 0.3/0.5/0.65/0.8); Seed; Porosity (0.6, how much it darkens); Darkest (0.45, darkness of a soaked porous surface; setts end at ~0.72 of dry); Wet Roughness (0.3 ground, 0.45 walls, 0.6 flags in EEVEE); Puddle Roughness (0.08; 0.03 gave black-hole puddles); Specular Boost (0.25: Specular IOR Level 0.5 -> 0.75); Relief Flatten (0.35; 1.0 cures sparkly flags); Puddle Darkness (0.9); Puddle Bias (0; +0.21 on pavements gives them ~a third of the road's puddles); Lowness (0.5, supplied by caller); Dry Tops (0.5); Water Level (0.65); Ground Slope (0.0699), Ground Offset (0), Wall Band (0.45 m), Wall Wetness (0.35), Streaks (0.5), Drip Mask (0, from the WETNESS DRIP sub-group: one hanging streak per source, chained for each window sill and the eaves from the street builder's FACADE_LAYOUTS numbers); five switches Colour/Roughness/Specular/Coat/Normal Effect (1). Outputs: Colour, Roughness, Specular IOR Level, Coat Weight, Coat Roughness, Normal, Height, Wet Mask, Puddle Mask, Streak Mask, Puddle Depth (Coat IOR set to 1.33 outside). Writes via photographing (orthographic emission renders): wet colour, roughness, coat, coat roughness, specularity, wet normal, puddle and wet masks.
materials_changed: Layer added (Poly Haven roughness+height pictures added for the first four): street_setts (porosity 0.6, wet rough 0.3, Lowness from crown to gutter), pavement_flags (0.55, 0.45, Lowness 1 at kerb, Relief Flatten 0.6, Puddle Bias 0.21), cottage_brick (0.7, 0.45) and cottage_stone (0.6, 0.45) measured in the wall's own coordinates with one material copy per facade layout carrying its own sill/eaves streaks, channel_stones (0.5, 0.3, wetness x1.15), kerb_stone (0.5, 0.35), colliery_brick, dressed_stone, dark_dressed_stone, roof_slate (0.3, 0.25), colliery_yard. NO material was replaced by a texture recipe (plan: road setts only as a second step after a painter test). In the wet glb the ground (road, gutter, pavements) and the 4 cottage-front meshes wear baked maps; the other 7 materials (kerb, brick/stone chimneys, colliery brick, dressed stones, slate, yard) wear flat wet numbers. All work on copies in street_wet/set_copy; the film project was not touched.

stage_check: Done in a copy of the film kit's stage files (stage_test/), three.js 0.169, Chromium headless with software graphics (SwiftShader), the kit's real projected-set.js. (1) Maps arrive: GLTFLoader reports roughnessMap, clearcoatMap, clearcoatRoughnessMap, specularIntensityMap (all channel 1 = UV2), specularColor 1.5 on street_setts_wet, pavement_flags_wet, channel_stones_wet and the 4 wall materials; normal map on channel 0. (2) They change the picture: own dusk-environment stand-in, road mean brightness 0.225 today glb, 0.181 wet glb maps off, 0.492 +roughness map (mean change 0.31), 0.526 +clear coat maps (0.035), 0.520 +specularity map (0.006): specularity changes least, as the study predicted. (3) Through projectPaintingOnto with the wet Cycles picture C as stand-in painting: plate view equals the painting (mean difference 0.002 on the road); in a moved view (1.4 m forward, 0.3 right) only 1.97 % wears the glb's own surface; today glb vs wet glb differ by 0.0004, matte on vs off by 0.0019 (0.0007 on road): the roughness/specular/coat maps do NOT reach the film as the stage is today (matteCopy discards them and the painting covers ~98 %); matte off makes uncovered surfaces ~4.7x brighter (0.064 vs 0.298) so the stage's tint would need re-tuning. Bug found by the stage test and fixed: interior_dark had gone into the first glb as an empty white metal (door slab). Stage test uses my stand-in environment/lamps, not the stage's own dusk.
timings: Cycles main camera 540x960 32 spp (2 threads, shared 4-core machine, load 5-7): A 234.7 s, B 237.0 s, C 262.2 s, D 253.1 s, baked street 252.6 s; close-ups 640x480 40 spp 129-198 s; five-card test 83-106 s; puddle sweep/wall masks ~1.3 s a picture (1 sample); colour-ratio run a few seconds. Bake run 13 min 20 s in background (photographing 791 s for 32 maps, glb export 6.5 s), over the 9-minute guide; --reuse rebuild of materials+glb 8 s. EEVEE 540x960 16 spp via xvfb-run: ray tracing on 199.5 s, off 126.3 s, pavement-cure test 79.3 s. Stage: still 7-13 s, projected still 16-30 s (software graphics). About 28 Blender runs in all (7 under a minute), above the ~20 budget because of two bugs and extra checks.
failures: Five-card test lighting needed three tries (point lamp missed right cards; 2500 W strip blew the dry cards out; 650 W worked)
Pavement puddles at 24 % of pavement at dial 0.5 with the plain dial; fixed by adding the Puddle Bias input (0.21)
Plan aim for wet road brightness 1.3-1.6x not met: 2.0x today (2.44x B); not clipped (0.4 % of road dots above 0.97) but not lowered
Wall wet band at the foot mostly hidden behind the dressed-stone plinth (floor stands 0.15-0.46 m above pavement); band 0.75 m tried, hardly visible at dusk; left at 0.45
BUG: bake photographing left interior_dark wired to black emission; first glb carried it as empty white metal (engine house door grey slab in stage); found only by the stage test, fixed
BUG: baked .blend saved with the photographing settings (no world light, no film look): first live-vs-baked comparison invalid (baked/live 0.29); fixed and re-drawn

Stage test slips: wrong property for environment strength (three.js 0.169 needs scene.environmentIntensity), projected stills dark because the kit writes the painting after colour encoding and relies on its finishing pass; fixed in the runner
